about_the_game:
Set sail in the Wyrd Waters Demo, a tactical multiplayer naval game set in fantastical, mythological Anglo-Saxon-inspired Seas. In this demo, you can create public or private PvP matches with up to 8 players and command a selection of ships, each with distinct tactical roles.

Inclusivity is important, your friends shouldn't left out on Mac, Linux or the Steam Deck. We made it a priority for anyone to be able to play Wyrd Waters!

Demo Features:

  • Multiplayer Battles: Engage in PvP combat for up to 8 players, testing your naval tactics against friends and foes.

  • Strategic Fleet Building: Choose from a limited roster of ships, each with its own unique strengths and abilities.

  • Mythological Setting: Navigate Kraken-infested waters inspired by Anglo-Saxon folklore, where every encounter is unpredictable.

What to Expect in the Full Release:

  • More Ships: The shipyard has more than doubled the unique ships to choose from. 

  • More Maps: Pick between Whirlpool Rapids, The Krakens domain or a Depleted battlefield!

  • Progression System: Rewarding players with unlocks, or additional content beyond the available ships and maps and SKINS!

Wishlist the full version of Wyrd Waters to stay in the loop. Join our Discord for community playtests and announcements!
